q: What DOH document must be secured before constructing, expanding or substantially renovating a hospital?
n: The PTC is a prerequisite for the License to Operate. Remember this: "15-1-365-10": HFSRB decides in 15 working days, the PTC is valid 1 year, work must start within 365 days, and appeals are filed within 10 days.

q: How long is a DOH-PTC valid after approval?
n: Valid one (1) year, subject to the terms and conditions in Annex I.

q: Within how many working days shall HFSRB or the Regional Office approve or disapprove a PTC application?
n: Fifteen (15) working days; the same timeline applies to the second review.

q: How many sets of architectural floor plans, signed and sealed by an architect and/or engineer, must be submitted?
n: Three sets; an electronic copy may also be emailed.

q: The PTC lapses and the fee is forfeited if work does not start within how many days from issuance?
n: Then a new application must be filed.

q: Within how many days after receiving a decision may an aggrieved facility appeal to the Office for Health Regulation?
n: Final appeal goes to the Secretary of Health.

q: Which professional is required as a minimum member of the Health Facilities Evaluation and Review Committee (HFERC)?
n: Minimum members: architect/engineer, physician, nurse; other experts may be invited.

q: Under AO 2016-0042, which office processes the PTC for Level 2 and 3 hospitals?
n: ROs handle birthing homes, Level 1 and HFEP hospitals, infirmaries and psychiatric facilities. (AO 2021-0014 later decentralized Levels 2–3 to the CHDs.)

q: What happens if an application is disapproved after the SECOND review?
o: The permit is issued with conditions
The applicant must re-apply and pay a new fee
A third review is done for free
The case goes to the Secretary of Health
n: Second review is free; after that, re-application with payment.

q: Whose standards apply to the physical plant of hospital radiology services under AO 2016-0042?
o: The Center for Device Regulation, Radiation Health and Research (CDRRHR)
n: Radiology physical plant follows CDRRHR standards.

q: What penalty does AO 2016-0042 prescribe for violations?
o: Issuance of a Cease and Desist Order
n: Violations are penalized through a Cease and Desist Order.

q: A PTC was issued on March 1, but construction is still not started on March 5 of the following year. What is the status?
o: It is still valid until the LTO is issued
It remains valid if the fee was paid
The PTC has lapsed and a new application must be filed
It is automatically extended for 6 months
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042 (Dec. 14, 2016), Annex I, item 4; Sec. VII
n: Work must begin within 365 days; otherwise the permit lapses and the fee is forfeited.
